spans.s: तिथिः [tithiḥ], m. or f. [अत्-इथिन् पृषो˚ वा ङीप् cf.
A lunar day; तिथिरेव तावन्न शउद्ध्यति
The number '15'. -Comp. -अर्धः, -र्धम् (half the तिथि), a Karaṇa. -ईशः the regent of a lunar day.
क्षयः the day of new moon.

the day on which a tithi begins and ends without one sunrise or between two sunrises. -पत्री an almanac.-पालनम् observance of the rites prescribed for the several lunar days. -प्रणीः (-णिः) the moon; सायंतनीं तिथिप्रण्यः पङ्कजानां दिवातनीम्
. -प्रलयः (pl.) difference between solar and lunar days in any particular period; Aryabhaṭṭa 3.6. -वृद्धिः f. the day in which a tithi is completed under two suns (one which comprises two sunrises).
